description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Scholar of the Ages.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Scholar of the Ages from exile to the battlefield.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
